children: GE Aerospace (NYSE:GE) is riding strong order and services momentum—huge backlogs, rising commercial services revenue, expanding engine install base and shop visits through 2030, major fleet orders and India co‑production plans—while facing analyst cuts and a reported cyber data breach.
Previous Week Recap
GE Aerospace Backlog And Growth
: GE Aerospace: $170B services backlog, $210B total backlog. Company expects commercial services revenue to rise >20% in 2026. Elevated engine removals and shop demand support aftermarket into 2027.
GEnx Deliveries Surge, Backlog Growth
: GE Aerospace (GE) Q2: GEnx deliveries +50% YoY; GEnx fastest wide-body cycle count at 50M cycles; backlog >2,000 engines; installed base set to double 2024–2030; win rate >95% since 2022
Engine Outlook And Visits Rise
: GE Aerospace updated engine outlook: modest CFM56 retirements and ~2,300–2,400 CFM56 shop visits in 2026–27; LEAP durability kits to align time‑on‑wing and LEAP shop visits set to grow through 2030
Order Momentum From IndiGo, Korean Air
: GE Aerospace (GE) reported strong post‑Farnborough order momentum: IndiGo ordered 1,000+ LEAP‑1A engines, and Korean Air placed a 100‑engine order including engines and services.
GE9X Mid-Seal; 777X Entry
: GE Aerospace shipped GE9X engines with an improved mid-seal to Boeing in Q3. Company says the mid-seal won’t delay Boeing 777X entry into service next year.
Melius Cuts GE Aerospace Rating
: Melius cut GE Aerospace (GE) to Hold and trimmed its price target to $350 from $432. Shares fell over 1% premarket. Analyst cited likely slowdown in commercial aftermarket growth.
CPP Deal Not Broad Roadmap
: GE Aerospace (GE) CFO Rahul Ghai said the CPP deal is unique, not a roadmap for broad vertical integration. He noted industry capacity limits mean extra manufacturing capacity will be needed.
Co-Production Of 99 F414-INS6
: GE Aerospace to provide commercial proposal for co-production of 99 F414-INS6 engines in India; HAL expects Ministry of Defence AoN by October, then contract signing can proceed.
F404‑IN20 Shipments To HAL
: GE Aerospace (GE) shipped 10 F404‑IN20 engines to HAL for Tejas Mk‑1A; HAL aims to deliver 10 LCA Mk‑1A jets by March. GE committed to supply 12 more F404‑IN20 engines by December.
Cl0p Hack Target GE Aerospace
: Cybercrime group claiming to hack Cl0p says it stole data from GE Aerospace (GE), listing GE among about 50 breached firms and asserting possession of GE data from the incident
